scripts.dev:backend:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec backend sh
scripts.dev:frontend:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec frontend sh
scripts.dev:valkey:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec valkey sh
scripts.dev:insight:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec redis-insight sh
scripts.dev:backend:install: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec backend npm install
scripts.dev:frontend:install: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec frontend npm install
scripts.dev:valkey:ping: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec valkey valkey-cli ping
scripts.dev:backend:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop backend && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f backend && docker volume rm perplexity-dev_backend_node_modules && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build backend
scripts.dev:frontend:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml stop frontend && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml rm -f frontend && docker volume rm perplexity-dev_frontend_node_modules && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build frontend
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down --rmi local && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.dev:reset:full: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down --rmi local -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build
scripts.prod:valkey:ping: docker compose exec valkey valkey-cli ping
